about.text: The soft, white, very moist fresh cheese of Brazil, named for Minas Gerais: milk is set with rennet, the raw curd is drained and the cheese is eaten fresh, often with guava paste (Romeu e Julieta).

steps.note: With rennet and/or other suitable enzymes, optionally selected lactic bacteria.
